repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUjtV7ahUH66wxpMk7

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION · `Check Changeset` is red by design on head `fb8b3f20`**

The one failing check is `Check Changeset`, and its log names one file: `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md` exists on the merge base and this PR changes it. That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, not a filename collision. The PR adds its own changeset under a different name (`.changeset/37796-skills-agent-model-provider-retired.md`).

The corrected note is the pending release note of PR #37765. It ships in the same release as this change, and it said two things this PR makes false:

- Title, before: "docs(skills): an agent's model name and provider are optional". After: "docs(skills): an agent's model name is optional".
- Body, before: the skill teaches "that `model.provider` is optional with no default (the deployment's choice) instead of defaulting to `openai`. The inline enum list is unchanged, and the schema citation now points at `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:37-45`", and the eval case "states the provider has no default". After: "It no longer says `model.provider` defaults to `openai`; the key itself leaves the page in the same release (see the changeset on the skill no longer teaching `model.provider`)", and the eval case "accepts an omitted `model`".

Nothing else in that note changed. The full before and after text is in the PR body under "DELIBERATE CORRECTION". The check stays red; the dispatching seat confirms the correction in its contract review on this head.

---

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fb8b3f20419216ec4c83505668209406797f1bf8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json + none
Security-touching: no

Read for this record: card #37796 and its six comments, the PR body, the four-file list and the net diff against `main`, PR comment 7211706378, the 45 check-runs on this head, and the code the skill cites on `main` at `f19ae3a8`. `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` and both skill files are the same there as on the PR base `10284387`. The two eval rounds were read from their run records in the project folder (`37796/`), answer by answer, and the final tokens were matched against the recorded answers by literal search. Nothing was built or re-run.

Check-runs on this head: 27 success, 17 skipped, 1 failure. The failure is `Check Changeset`, and inside it one step alone: "Reject an empty-frontmatter changeset added by this PR", which names `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md` and nothing else. The other steps of that job pass, among them the changeset requirement, the ADR-0087 disposition and the level axis (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no entry above `patch`).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of the metadata protocol: unchanged. Right.** The diff touches no `packages/spec` path. `agent.model.provider` has been refused on `main` since `f07d63a510` (PR #37783). This PR changes what the skill teaches, not what the platform accepts.
- **Published surface: the `@objectstack/skills` text of `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, Model Configuration. Right.** The `provider` row leaves the table and three sentences arrive above it. Each is judged against the spec in ④.
- **Citation `agent.zod.ts:87-95`. Right.** On `main`, `:87` is `provider: retiredKey(MODEL_PROVIDER_RETIRED)`, `:88-92` is `model`, `:93` is `temperature`, `:94` is `maxTokens` and `:95` is `topP`. The old `:37-45` now points into the retirement comment and the first lines of the refusal string.
- **What eval case 2 accepts. Right, with nit N2.** The prompt is unchanged. `must_contain` drops `provider` and `anthropic` and adds `deployment`. `must_not_contain` goes from empty to the line `provider: 'anthropic',`.
- **The Model Registry (`ModelProviderSchema`). Right.** Its only mention in the bundle sat inside the removed row, as a contrast with the inline enum. With the enum gone the contrast has no anchor, and the PR adds no new description of the registry. That is what the card asks.
- **Token ceiling. Right.** The row for `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` stays `6801` in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on `main`, that script is not in the diff, and the ratchet's job is green on this head. No limit was raised.
- **Rest of the bundle. Right.** A search of `skills/` on `main` finds an agent's `model.provider` taught in these two places only. Every other `provider` in the bundle is a view data source, a connector, an auth provider or an embedding reference.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/37796-skills-agent-model-provider-retired.md` grades `@objectstack/skills` at `patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the PR body carries the same two lines. That matches the diff: published prose and one eval fixture, with no key, value or default of the protocol moved.

Clause-②: `no` is right. No contract face under `packages/spec/src/**` is in the diff.

The new note's sentences agree with the diff. One remark for the lane seat, ungraded because a changeset is outside ④: "An answer that quotes the retired spelling to warn against it still passes" is true of the quote the rounds produced (`provider: 'anthropic'` in prose, no comma). A warning that shows the refused object-literal line with its trailing comma would fail.

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION of `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md` (the pending note of PR #37765).** The note is still pending: the last version commit (`33a31dc7b0`) predates #37765, so it ships in the same release as this change and as the retirement note `37712`. Its frontmatter and its `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines are unchanged. Each rewritten sentence, judged against the tree at this head:

1. Title. Before: "an agent's model name and provider are optional". After: "an agent's model name is optional". The old title would be false on release day, when `provider` is refused, not optional. The new one is true: `model` is `z.string().optional()` at `:88`. **Holds.**
2. Body, first sentence. The clause "and that `model.provider` is optional with no default (the deployment's choice) instead of defaulting to `openai`" is removed. What remains says the skill teaches that `model.model` is optional and that an agent without one runs on the host's default model. That is the `model` row on this head. **Holds.**
3. Body, new sentence: "It no longer says `model.provider` defaults to `openai`; the key itself leaves the page in the same release (see the changeset on the skill no longer teaching `model.provider`)." The first half is true: the page said "(default `openai`)" before #37765 and says it nowhere now. The second half is true of what the page teaches: the row and its enum are gone. It is loose on the letter, because the page keeps one line that names `provider` as retired. The pointer leads to the note that says so exactly. **Holds**, with that remark.
4. Body, removed sentence: "The inline enum list is unchanged, and the schema citation now points at `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:37-45`." Both halves would be false on release day: the enum list is gone and the citation is `:87-95`. The new note carries the new citation. **Removal holds.**
5. Body, eval sentence. Before: the case "accepts an omitted `model` and states the provider has no default". After: the case "accepts an omitted `model`". The expected output on this head says "or omits it to run on the host's default model" and no longer speaks of a provider default. **Holds.**
6. Body, "Published prose only" sentence. Before: "the optional `model` / `provider` already on main since #37697". After: "the optional `model` already on main since #37697". #37697 (`3e87d7b634`) made `model` optional. **Holds.**

The note's last sentence, on the token budget, is unchanged.

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION: confirmed** for `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md`, all six rewritten sentences. The red `Check Changeset` on this head is that correction and nothing else.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the dev report. Nothing to answer.
- **Dev flag, class a: the eval runner hands its whole environment to every turn.** Confirmed in the records. All three round 1 no-skill answers for case 2 cite team memory on card #37712. No round 2 answer does. One more reading for the seat's card: two of the three round 2 no-skill turns for case 2 loaded an ambient `claude-api` skill, so the no-skill arm is not free of the container's own skills either. It did not help them: all three answers are wrong on the taught point. Not this diff's to fix. The seat files it.
- **Dev flag: cases 6 and 7 miss literal phrases on the with-skill arm in both rounds.** The diff changes case 2 only, so this PR did not move them. A grading-token question for its own card; the seat decides.
- **Dev flag: `SKILL.md:457` cites `agent.zod.ts:234, :251` for the `agent.tools` / `agent.knowledge` tombstones.** Confirmed stale on `main`: `:234` is the `StructuredOutputConfig` type and `:251` is `LONG_TERM_STORE_RETIRED`. The line is outside this diff's hunks. A follow-up card, the seat's to file.
- **Acceptance note: the description still lists "configuring an LLM provider".** Agreed. The section now answers that question by saying where the provider is chosen, and changing the trigger is not on the card.
- **Acceptance note: branch `claude/project-thread-2rm2nh`.** Harness-assigned. It is the branch on the claim, and this record signs with it.
- **Claim amendment 7211698119** (file surface adds the foreign changeset): judged under ②.
- **Human Minimum boxes left open** (lint, the test jobs): every Lint, Type Check and Test job on this head is green. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, not measured by the dev, runs inside `Build Core`, which is green.
- SQL push-down: the diff holds no query code. Nothing to judge.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`**, against the spec on `main` and the card's scenario:

- "Sampling lives under an agent's `model` (`AIModelConfigSchema`), never a top-level `temperature` / `maxTokens` (`…agent.zod.ts:87-95`)." Holds. The range is the block's key list.
- "The block names a model, never a provider: the deployment's AI settings choose the provider and resolve the model name among the providers turned on." Holds. It is the refusal an author meets at `:39-45` ("the provider that serves an agent is chosen by the deployment's AI settings, never by the agent … the deployment resolves that name among the providers it has turned on"), and the protocol-19 entry `agent-model-provider-retired` says the same. The settings side exists in this repo: `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai-models.ts` has a default `provider`, a `_enabled` switch per provider, and `anthropic` on its list.
- "`provider` is retired (protocol 19): writing it is a parse error. Delete it." Holds. `retiredKey` at `:87`, conversion `agent-model-provider-removed` with `toMajor: 19`, and a prescription that says "Delete the key". See N1.
- The three rows left in the table still match `:88-95`.
- Tried against the card's prompt: all three round 2 with-skill answers put `temperature: 0.3` and `maxTokens: 2000` under `model`, write no provider key, and send Anthropic to the deployment's AI settings. That is the behaviour the card asks for.

**`skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`**, case 2:

- The expected output agrees with the three sentences above and with the `model` row, clause by clause. The prompt still exercises the agent model block.
- Dropping `provider` and `anthropic` from `must_contain` is right. The first would require the retired word. The second is matched case-sensitively, and a correct answer writes "Anthropic".
- **The narrowing from `provider:` to `provider: 'anthropic',` holds.** Round 1 scored case 2 with-skill 1/3 under the bare token. I read the two failing answers: each writes no provider key and each says that writing `provider: 'anthropic'` now fails to parse. A bare `provider:` graded a correct warning as a failure. Under the final tokens all six with-skill answers of the two rounds pass. In round 2 all three no-skill answers fail twice over: each carries the forbidden line and each lacks `deployment`. So the case does not rest on the one spelling.
- Round 2 as recorded on this head: case 2 with-skill 3/3, no-skill 0/3; the pack 30/36 against 1/36, 72 of 72 turns in the denominator. The with-skill misses are cases 5, 6 and 7.

N1 (nit) — "writing it is a parse error" is true of every value except one. `provider: 'openai'`, the default the 18.x toolchain wrote into parsed agents, is accepted at parse and stripped (`acceptRetiredDefaultResidue`, `agent.zod.ts:62`, `:71` and `:96`); `tsc` refuses it like any other value. The instruction the skill gives, never write it and delete it, is right for every value, and the schema's own jsdoc at `:81-86` uses the same words. The file has no token headroom. Left as an accepted deviation.

N2 (nit) — the forbidden token is one spelling. `provider: "anthropic"`, or the key as the last one with no trailing comma, slips past it, and the case then rests on `deployment` alone. In the other direction, a correct answer that shows the refused object-literal line as a counter-example would fail. Neither appeared in twelve answers. Left as measured; a later round that shows either is the time to widen it.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么：** 发布目录里的 objectstack-ai 技能页，代理的模型表去掉 `provider` 一行，写明 model 块只写模型名，提供方由部署的 AI 设置决定，写了 `provider` 要删掉。这是 #37783（`model.provider` 退役，已合并）的技能跟进。评测第 2 例改成按新写法判分。
- **影响：** 用技能写代理的 AI 和开发者不会再照旧写法填 `provider`。实测带技能 3/3、不带技能 0/3；整包 30/36 对 1/36。产品行为不变。
- **请你留意：**
  - **Check Changeset 是红的，这是有意的。** 这个 PR 改了 #37765 留下、还没发版的 changeset 里已经不成立的几句话（它说 `provider` 可选）。改动在 PR 评论 7211706378 和正文里逐句声明，同 head 的契约审核 PASS（7212225008）已逐句确认，不用等它变绿。
  - 技能页的令牌数仍是 6801，没有抬上限。
  - 跟进：#37850（两处小措辞、一处过时行号、评测判分）；#37842（评测运行器把项目记忆带进了两臂，这次第二轮已排除）。
- **审核：** 契约审核（最高档）PASS，没有必须改或建议改的项。席位 L1 ACCEPT 在本评论前一条（7212265380）。
- **要你做什么：** 技能文件是受管面，需要你批准后才能合并。撤回这一次合并即可恢复原样。
